mechanism_inventory: missing invariant enforcement (maxSupply cap uses pre-mint totalSupply)
stale accounting snapshot (totalSupply read before mint)
external-call failure / DoS via onZetaMessage/onZetaRevert callback to untrusted destinationAddress
hook caller/timing mismatch (callback after mint enables reentrancy/state manipulation)
value exceeds bound (maxSupply set to 0/arbitrary low by TSS, griefing)

selected_mechanisms.root_cause: maxSupply check reads totalSupply() BEFORE minting; after mint succeeds the ZetaReceiver callback (onZetaMessage/onZetaRevert) is invoked on attacker-controlled destinationAddress AFTER the mint, allowing the receiver to act on freshly minted tokens or re-enter before post-call updates.
selected_mechanisms.attacker_model: Attacker controls destination address on target chain; crafts cross-chain send where destinationAddress is malicious. TSS mints to it then calls onZetaMessage.
selected_mechanisms.exploit_path: 1. send with destinationAddress=malicious. 2. TSS onReceive. 3. maxSupply passes. 4. mint to attacker contract. 5. onZetaMessage called. 6. attacker uses minted tokens / calls send() to re-send before any revert.
selected_mechanisms.who_loses: Protocol / other holders if mint+callback enables double-spend; recipients if callback revert loses tokens.
selected_mechanisms.why_carried: Mint before external callback to untrusted address — classic CEI violation; callback target user-supplied.

unresolved_mechanisms.mechanism: stale accounting / maxSupply bypass via concurrent mints or callback burn
unresolved_mechanisms.source_evidence: both onReceive/onRevert read totalSupply() at check then mint; callback could burn then allow a second mint to pass cap.
unresolved_mechanisms.unresolved_question: Whether TSS submits serially/concurrently and whether callback burn enables a second mint within the cap.

unresolved_mechanisms.mechanism: onZetaMessage revert reverts onReceive — burn on source, no mint on destination (permanent fund loss)
unresolved_mechanisms.source_evidence: onZetaMessage called without try/catch; revert reverts the mint; source-chain burn already happened in send().
unresolved_mechanisms.unresolved_question: Whether protocol retries/replays a failed onReceive or value is permanently lost — depends on TSS/off-chain infra.
unresolved_mechanisms.who_loses: End user (burned on source, never received on destination).

rejected_mechanisms.rejecting_source_fact: guarded by onlyTssAddress; no permissionless entry.
rejected_mechanisms.why_unexploitable: TSS-only; key compromise out of scope at this level.

impact_direction.attacker_receives: Freshly minted tokens usable inside the onZetaMessage callback before tx completes.
impact_direction.victim_loses: Supply integrity if callback enables double-accounting; end users lose permanently if callback reverts (burn on source, no mint).
impact_direction.invariant_violated: CEI: mint precedes external call to untrusted user-supplied address; maxSupply cross-chain cap potentially violated.
impact_direction.not_self_funded_or_dust_or_admin_or_timi: DoS/fund-loss path requires no privilege and affects real cross-chain value; callback reentrancy requires only control of a destination address (user-supplied).

stop_condition: more_mechanisms_pending: supply-cap stale-snapshot and callback-revert fund destruction unresolved, different actors/variables than primary
